headline: Flipping storage_encrypted on a live RDS instance forces destroy-and-recreate, wiping all production data

findings.evidence_ref: data_stores.tf: storage_encrypted changed false → true on an existing aws_db_instance. storage_encrypted is a ForceNew attribute in the AWS Terraform provider; Terraform's plan will show a -/+ replace action that destroys the current instance and creates a blank encrypted one.
findings.explanation: AWS cannot enable encryption in-place on an existing unencrypted RDS instance. Applying this diff will delete the production database and all its data before standing up a new, empty, encrypted instance. The correct migration path is: snapshot the instance, copy the snapshot with encryption enabled, then restore a new instance from that encrypted snapshot and cut over.
